lockfileScope: all locked packages; yanks not checked
waiverScope: Only the listed browser artifact versions built from the listed lock and wasm32-unknown-unknown graphs/features. No native or future artifacts; re-evaluate on a lock, graph or artifact change. Warnings are separate and are not waivers.

findings.title: Stack overflow in `Url::origin()` on nested `blob:` URLs
findings.waiver: This locked URL dependency is absent from both the selected WASM normal graph and the host-inclusive production closure.

findings.title: Insecure Preservation of SUID/SGID Bits during ZIP Extraction Leading to Potential Privilege Escalation
findings.waiver: ZIP members stay in memory; the editor does not extract a ZIP to a host filesystem or preserve privileged filesystem mode bits.

findings.title: AES entries returned without checking their authentication code when the data ends early or is empty
findings.waiver: The pinned WASM zip 3.0.0 feature set does not include AES, so it does not build the affected AES implementation.

findings.title: ZipStreamReader::extract() and ZipArchive::extract() apply Unix permissions through symlinks without confining the target
findings.waiver: ZIP members stay in memory; the editor does not extract to a filesystem or apply archived permissions through symlinks.

findings.title: zip: `ZipArchive::extract` creates symbolic links whose attacker-controlled targets are outside the destination directory
findings.waiver: ZIP members stay in memory; the editor does not invoke the filesystem extraction API that creates symlinks.

findings.title: `ZipStreamReader` extracts entries under local-header names that can differ from the central directory
findings.waiver: The document import paths use seekable, in-memory ZipArchive readers, not the streaming extraction API.

findings.title: zip: `ZipArchive::extract` aborts the process on a symlink entry with a large declared size
findings.waiver: ZIP members stay in memory; the editor does not invoke the filesystem extraction API or its special handling of symlink entries.

warnings.title: xattr functions mark unwritten bytes as initialized when given a zero-length buffer
`AsyncFd::new` and related constructors violate I/O safety
